cohort: Infertile patients with a history of previous cesarean delivery who underwent embryo transfer and hysteroscopic evaluation of the cesarean section scar at a reproductive center in China between January 2020 and December 2022.
finding: Intrauterine fluid accumulation (IUF) was an independent risk factor for significantly lower clinical pregnancy and live birth rates in infertile women with a history of cesarean section, whereas cesarean scar diverticulum (CSD) had no significant effect.
